red__imagescale.pro


Routines

top source red::imagescale

SST pipeline

result = red::imagescale(pref [, /no_gridfile] [, /use_config], use_measurement=use_measurement [, /verbose])

Calculate the image scale based on pinhole grid pitch measurements.

The CRISP image scale depends on the prefilter for some years. If no measurements exist, just use the default from the config file.

Try to get a value, using these sources in order: 1. self.image_scales (from raw pinholes, written in config file), 2. measurements from file (by the pinhole alignment step), 3. measure from summed pinholes, 4. self.image_scale. The first 3 are individual measurments for different prefilters. The last one is common to all prefilters.

Return value

The image plate scale in arcsec per pixel.

Parameters

pref in type=string

The prefilter for which to calculate the image scale.

Keywords

no_gridfile in optional type=boolean

Do not use the pre-measured gridhole pitch values.

use_config in optional type=boolean

Use the image scales from the config file, self.image_scale or self.image_scales, and not those measured for this day.

use_measurement
verbose in optional type=boolean

Write messages about what we are doing.
